title: Sunseeker Manhattan 55
highlights: Beach club with platform seat, overhead shower and marine grill
Flybridge with hard top, electric canopy, BBQ and wet bar
Platinum Mediterranean package: tropical A/C, upgraded generator, stern thruster
Simrad navigation package with radar, autopilot and AIS
Master, VIP and twin cabins plus crew cabin
description:
The 2025 Sunseeker Manhattan 55 offers owners a wide range of social spaces usually seen on larger yachts. Extensive curved glass and stainless-steel detailing define her exterior, and the galley flows onto the main deck for a seamless transition from indoors to outdoors.

At the stern, the bathing platform and beach club offer a built-in marine grill, an overhead shower and fold-down seating. Up top, the flybridge has a hard top with retractable canopies, a helm station, a BBQ, a wet bar and a sunbed.

She sleeps 6 guests in 3 cabins: a master with island berth and en-suite, a VIP with en-suite and a twin cabin, plus a crew cabin for 2. Twin MAN i6-800 engines give up to 32 knots. This yacht comes with the Platinum Mediterranean package, a joystick docking system and a full Simrad navigation package.

Located in the UAE. Contact us for the full specification and a private viewing.
